Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with diarrhea for approximately three days.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: diarrhoea, for, for, yeah. So, it's lasting for like three days.
Uh, I have a bit of uh, pain, abdominal pain.
And I, had a bit of vomiting.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Diarrhea has neither improved nor worsened over the last three days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I , I think it, it's not getting better or worse. It's kind of like uh, uh, like, middle, like normal, like uh, it, it, it hasn't gone away, it hasn't worsened.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient experiences the urge to defecate again immediately after finishing (tenesmus).
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I go to the toilet, and then when I finish, I need to, I feel I need to go again.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient needs to stay close to the toilet due to frequent bowel movements.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: So, I need to be like close to the toilet uh, all the time.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports very frequent toilet use, approximately every ten minutes.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I, I, I, yeah I try not to eat a lot because I, yeah I just, going to the toilet every, ten minute.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Abdominal pain is localized to the center of the abdomen under the belly button.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: the pain is mainly uh, focus in, in the centre area of the abdomen, like under the belly, under the belly button.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports audible stomach noises.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: and sometimes I can hear my stomach, uh, like, it comes, uh, yeah.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Abdominal pain is partially relieved after using the toilet.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it seems to be alleviate a bit, toilet

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Last vomiting episode occurred this morning.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I think it was this morning. This morning, I, but the, the thing is like, because I'm not eating anything now. So, I, I haven't vomited again.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient had nausea before vomiting after eating fruit.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: then I got a bit of nausea, and I vomited, and then, uh, yeah and that was it, and that was it.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies blood in vomit.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I don't think there is blood because uh, yeah it was, it was the strawberries that I was having for breakfast. So, so, yeah, it wasn't blood.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has not noticed any blood.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Uh, no, I haven't noticed any, any blood.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is limiting food intake due to frequent bowel movements.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I, I, I, yeah I try not to eat a lot because I, yeah I just, going to the toilet every, ten minute.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient believes they are not drinking enough water.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I think I don't drink enough water.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports no chest pain.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: no, I haven't , I haven't noticed any chest pain.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No new breathing problems beyond baseline asthma.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Um, uh, I, I always have problems with my breathing, because of the asthma like, . When I, , I need to use my inhaler a little bit, but apart of the normal, I haven't, I haven't.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Walking and talking are normal.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Uh, walking and talking, uh, yes, yes.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies recent fever.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I didn't have any, fever recently.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is unsure if they had a mild fever.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Not sure if, if I had bit of fever, but very, little or, or, I'm, I'm but I don't think so, I don't think.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports sweating over the last four days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I, I was sweating a little bit the last four days

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is concerned the new inhaler may have caused the symptoms.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: And, uh, I don't know maybe this new one has cause it, this, this problem. I don't know.

Past_Medical_History.source_text: Uh, so I have, I have, I have a, asthma, and I take some uh, some uh, um, inhaler.

Medications.content: Recently switched to a new inhaler brand after the previous one ran out.
Medications.source_text: but my inhaler kind of um, run out the one. Because you know, I'm a foreigner, so I have uh, this brand, but I bought a new one here.

Medications.content: Uses the inhaler when feeling anxious.
Medications.source_text: sometimes I have, when I get a bit of anxiety, I, I use my inhaler.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: I have N, N, NK, NKDA allergy.

Family_History.content: Father died approximately ten years ago from bowel cancer.
Family_History.source_text: Because he died about um, ten years ago of bowel cancer.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Unable to work due to frequent need to use the toilet.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I can't go to work because I need to go like every.

Assessment.content: Clinical impression is gastroenteritis (infection of the gastrointestinal tract).
Assessment.source_text: this is normally called gastroenteritis, so, an infection of the tummy.

Assessment.content: Symptoms are thought to be due to eating something bad (foodborne illness).
Assessment.source_text: you might have eaten something bad, and it's causing your tummy pain.

Assessment.content: Inhaler is very unlikely to be the cause of the abdominal symptoms.
Assessment.source_text: It's very unlikely for an inhaler to cause tummy pain, like this.

Plan_of_Care.content: Increase oral fluids; drink lots of water and fluids.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Number one is to drink lots of water and fluids, because you're losing lots at the moment.
Number two is to make sure and look out for any fevers

Plan_of_Care.content: Stay home until feeling slightly better.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: And please stay home for the time being until you get slightly better.

Plan_of_Care.content: Avoid antibiotics as they are not helpful and may worsen the situation.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Normally, things like antibiotics don't help, they make the situation worse.

Follow_up_Information.content: If symptoms worsen, see a GP in person for abdominal assessment.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if you feel you're getting much worse, than I would suggest you go and see your GP in real, in real life, in person, so they can loot at your belly.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient plans to wait 1–2 days and then book a GP appointment.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: I will wait a couple of days to see, or one more day, and then I will book, and then, yeah.
